text:
alex: Quick sync — FinSight asked for a pay-per-peak 'burst' add-on so they can handle occasional traffic spikes without a higher commit. Need product + finance + eng tradeoffs. Goal: decide launch criteria, limits, and contract language. Thoughts?

jess: Who at FinSight? any expected spike shape / frequency?

alex: PM from FinSight — they said 2-3 big spikes/month, 10x baseline for ~15–30m. willing to pay >1.5x while active.

tom: Engineering note: this adds routing + metering complexity. two main options: (1) ring-fenced burst pool per-customer (expensive), or (2) dynamic routing to spot capacity + fallback. Both need per-request tagging and per-minute accounting. Also need throttle hooks to avoid noisy neighbor.
jess: For product framing, maybe call it "Surge Pack" with clear caps and a per-minute billing rate. small/medium/enterprise tiers?
maria: Finance: we need pricing bands. rough idea: small=+1.5x, medium=+2x, enterprise=custom. Also require a monthly cap to limit exposure and a hard stop % of baseline to avoid runaway costs. We should model tail risk (p99 usage).
sam: SLA implications — if customers route heavy traffic to the Surge Pack and we evict them, do we have to guarantee throughput? Legal will want opt-in and no SLA guarantees for bursts.

tom: Prototype config sketch:
```json
{
  "surge_tier": "medium",
  "minute_cap_tokens": 500000,
  "overflow_behavior": "fallback-to-hosted-small",
  "metering_resolution": "per_minute"
}
```
This shows the per-minute cap and fallback. Need telemetry for peaks and a flag to enable savings (KV cache behavior).
jess: Pilot criteria suggestion: 3 customers, scripted load tests that emulate 10x for 30m, duration 3 weeks, no more than 2 incidents where fallback was triggered. Also require client opt-in + documented runbook.
maria: Launch metrics: incremental ARPA from burst, median token latency change <10ms, percent of requests hitting fallback <5%, and worst-case monthly spend per customer <3x proforma. If any fail, hold launch.
sam: Action items: product draft spec with UI + API; eng prototype metering + fallback; finance run pricing sims (best/expected/worst); legal draft addendum language. Need owners and dates.
alex: I'll own the spec and pilot plan. @tom please prototype metering by next Tue (1767300000). @maria run pricing sims by Wed EOD. @jess line up pilot customers and test scripts. @sam coordinate legal. Check-in Friday EOD. :thumbsup: 
jess: noted. I'll ping FinSight and two others.
tom: ack — will start with per-minute counter + fallback token. I'll post a short runbook once prototype runs.
maria: I'll share three pricing scenarios and sensitivity to number of spikes.
sam: I'll loop in legal and put a draft addendum in Drive.
alex: Cool — thanks everyone. We'll iterate on the spec in this thread.
